title: Decoder latency is not universally tens of microseconds
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x vs the 100 ns decision point: best primary complete loops are 446-550 ns readout-to-feedback at d=3 (Yang; Liu), 4.5-5.5x SLOWER than the assumed t_layer; the item can only confirm that 100 ns is quantum-favourable
cheapest_decisive_test: One versioned anchor table (existing anchors + at most 2 newest primary sources) with endpoint, distance, logical error, demonstrated/projected label, plus one column 'required reaction time for a 10x win at current depth' = 0.39 ns per Toffoli layer (B8x52) and 0.051 ns (B4x12) at eps=0.001, k=3. If every entry is >=100 ns, the decision-point clock is documented as quantum-favourable and the item closes.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close after the table if no primary source reports a sustained, application-distance (d>=15) complete reaction loop below 100 ns. Do NOT run the H18 admissibility check on anchors slower than 100 ns (moot: it can only worsen them). Reopen only on a new primary <100 ns complete-loop result.
notes: Merge H01+H02 into one half-day table. Its only value is documenting that the 100 ns decision point already beats every demonstrated/projected reaction loop, so the negative result's clock assumption is quantum-favourable.

title: Fast standalone decoding is not the entire reaction loop
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: separating kernel from complete loop can only raise latency above the kernel figure; the decision point (100 ns) is already below the best complete loops (446-550 ns)
cheapest_decisive_test: Add 'kernel latency' and 'complete reaction latency' as two fields in the H01 table for the two existing integrated-loop papers (Yang 550 ns; Liu 446 ns, d=3, larger d extrapolated); no new timeline modelling.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close together with H01. Do not build the two full acquisition-to-dispatch timelines unless HW-ACT fires (see H17 notes).
notes: Duplicate/sub-field of H01. Its stop rule (two complete timelines) is unnecessary work while the gap at 100 ns is 255-1,952x in Toffoli-layer depth.

title: A code cycle and a logical T layer are different quantities
optimistic_max_factor: 2-10x: zero-cost screen in this triage measured T-depth / Toffoli-layer depth = 4.00 exactly on emitted add72, mul72 and mul40 leaves (seven-T ASAP charges 4 T-layers per serial Toffoli); a further <=2x only if uncompute Toffolis become measurement-based (A16 credit). Shared with H06/H11, count once. Cannot close: B8 miss 1,018x -> 255x (127x with uncompute credit); B4 7,807x -> 1,952x at 100 ns, eps=0.001, k=3
real_dependencies: A16 (measurement-based uncompute, only for the extra <=2x)
cheapest_decisive_test: Re-run the existing gate_resources pass on the accepted B4/B8 source counting each CCX as one reaction layer (Cliffords free; optional commutation-aware variant that lets CCXs sharing only controls overlap). Output a D_reaction lower bound and the re-scored miss against D_max. Template: scratchpad/plan110/h_tools/ccx_depth_screen.py (seconds per leaf).
kill_or_defer_criterion: Adopt the Toffoli-layer depth as the depth in the negative frontier (T-depth overstates quantum time by up to 4x, which a referee would flag). Defer the full lattice-surgery chain mapping, and do not retry the reaction-map run that hit its frozen CPU cap, until HW-ACT.
notes: Only H-family item with a real (small) depth lever. The previous bounded attempt FAILED at its CPU cap with no credit; the screen replaces it at near-zero cost. Screen output: scratchpad/plan110/h_tools/ccx_depth_screen.json.

title: Repeating distance-many syndrome rounds per operation is not mandatory in every architecture
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x vs the 100 ns decision point: constant-round algorithmic fault tolerance still costs >=1 syndrome round + decode per layer (~1 us superconducting, ~ms neutral atoms); 100 ns is already below one round
cheapest_decisive_test: Zero cost: compare the AFT construction's per-layer floor (one physical syndrome round + decoding on its target platform) with 100 ns; if the floor is >=100 ns it cannot improve the decision point and the latency branch closes.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close the latency branch now if the floor is >=100 ns (true for all screened AFT papers and demonstrations). Keep only as an optional G5 route after HW-ACT.
notes: An advantage claim needs one compatible architecture (H17/G5), not this one specifically, hence 'neither'.

title: Fifteen-to-one distillation is not the only magic-state supply
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x on the full inequality: supply is a non-binding term of max(reaction, supply) at the decision point (implicitly unlimited factories); as a standalone necessary condition the tenfold rate is 1.9e15-7.6e16 accepted T/s (C04 frontier run002), so a 2-10x cultivation spacetime saving changes no verdict
cheapest_decisive_test: Already decisive at zero cost: divide the C04 tenfold supply thresholds by an explicitly generous per-factory rate (e.g. 1 accepted state per 100 ns per factory of >=1e3 physical qubits) -> >=1.9e8 factories and >=1.9e11 physical qubits for B8. Record it as a necessary-condition row; no further fixtures.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Freeze now (18 fixtures, two methods, delivery/buffer interface already sealed). Reopen only when the tenfold supply threshold is <=~1e10 accepted T/s (a >=1e5x cut in T demand per tenfold-budget second), or at HW-ACT.
notes: Already heavily executed (delivery interface, 88 buffer cases, capacity frontiers). Further percent-level supply certificates are wasted while the reaction term misses by >=255x.

title: T-state supply and Toffoli-state supply must be matched to the circuit
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x incremental: its depth effect is the same <=4x CCZ-layer credit already assigned to H03 (count once); its supply effect (one CCZ state instead of 7 T) acts on a non-binding term
cheapest_decisive_test: Fold into the H03 screen: export the CCX-layer count and residual T (1,759,815 IQFT T already separated) from the same pass; no separate native-CCZ lowering run.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Freeze after the H03 screen. Native-CCZ injection mapping and catalysis seed/storage obligations reopen only with H17 at HW-ACT.
notes: Overlaps H03 (depth credit) and H05 (supply). Guard against counting the same gate saving in H03, H06, H11 and any A-family T-depth-1 Toffoli / logical-AND item.

title: Distillation is not logically necessary for every non-Clifford implementation
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: protected cat-qubit logical gates are microsecond-scale (slower than the 100 ns decision point); the gain is removal of distillation footprint, which acts on the non-binding supply/space terms
cheapest_decisive_test: Zero cost: take the published cat-qubit CNOT/Toffoli durations (Guillaud-Mirrahimi; Gouzien et al.) and compare with 100 ns; if >=100 ns the latency branch cannot improve the decision point.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close the latency branch now (logical protected-adder gate-set audit already done; noise/duration interfaces stay open as a space-only conditional route). No noise or duration audit until HW-ACT and a space cap is binding.
notes: H07 and H08 are one route (cat qubits): H08 is the full-architecture continuation of H07.

title: An alternative physical qubit does not automatically eliminate all factories
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: complete cat architectures still pay Toffoli preparation, teleportation, routing and idling at microsecond-scale operation times; no route below 100 ns per layer
cheapest_decisive_test: Same zero-cost duration screen as H07; nothing further.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Defer until HW-ACT; kill if H07's duration screen shows >=100 ns per logical Toffoli layer (expected).
notes: Duplicate continuation of H07; one owner.

optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x on the time inequality: qLDPC memory compression changes physical-qubit footprint, not reaction depth, k, sigma/e or T_C; only indirect effect is more E20 lanes under a fixed physical budget, which E20 owns
cheapest_decisive_test: Already decisive: the bounded step found both source allocations reject for missing liveness/cap/conversion, with no savings. Apply its own stop rule (missing memory-to-logic conversion closes direct integration).
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close the direct-integration branch now under its own stop rule; retain the memory-only component result. Reopen only after HW-ACT with a binding physical-qubit cap.
notes: Space-only family (H09, H10, H12, H13, H15) shares one trigger: a declared physical-qubit cap that binds after HW-ACT.

title: High-rate codes also have logical-operation research
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: qLDPC logic reduces footprint; inter-block gates, addressability and code conversion add latency, so it cannot beat the 100 ns reaction-limited layer already granted
cheapest_decisive_test: None needed now; when activated, the cheapest test is a 32-bit adder mapping on one finite qLDPC logic scheme with charged inter-block gates.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Defer until H09 reopens (space cap binding after HW-ACT). Stop at the first missing non-Clifford interface (its own rule).
notes: Depends on H09, which closes now.

optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x incremental: the CCZ-per-layer gate-set gain is the same <=4x credit assigned to H03 (count once); physical CCZ plus stabilizer extraction keeps the layer >=~1 us, above the 100 ns decision point; factory removal acts on non-binding supply
cheapest_decisive_test: Already at its stop rule: the finite parameter bill exists but stabilizer/Clifford/noisy-CCZ implementations are missing, so the timing branch is unavailable.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close the timing branch now under its own stop rule; keep the coding-theory result separate from application cost. Reopen only with a physical CCZ implementation and HW-ACT.
notes: Overlaps H03/H06 for the CCZ-layer depth credit.

title: Constant asymptotic overhead is not a small finite constant
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: space-overhead theorem with unspecified constants; does not reduce logical depth or layer time (logarithmic-time overhead can only add time)
cheapest_decisive_test: Already decisive: the full-text audit found no usable finite constants/code lengths; its own stop rule closes the numerical-transfer branch.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close now as a theoretical alternative with no credited crossover. Do not assign any numeric overhead to O(1).
notes: Pure literature item; no further work in this program.

title: Idle space can dominate a physical mapping
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x: active-volume layouts cut idle spacetime volume (footprint/cost), not reaction depth; Litinski-Nickerson themselves assume ~1 us reaction, slower than the 100 ns already granted
cheapest_decisive_test: Already at its stop rule: component-block registries and ideal idle accounting exist; oriented topology/factory/reaction schedule is missing, so no accepted timing.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close the timing branch now; keep the component volume result. Reopen with H14 only after HW-ACT and a binding physical-qubit cap.
notes: Space/cost item; lower active volume is explicitly not a latency gain (its own acceptance rule).

title: Photonic clock rates cannot be inserted directly as logical-layer rates
optimistic_max_factor: 1.1-2x realistic, <=10x only in a hypothetical ~10 ns complete reaction loop: GHz resource-state clocks do not lower a reaction-limited layer below detection + feedforward + decoding; even 10 ns leaves B8 >=25x and B4 >=195x short of tenfold with the H03 credit
cheapest_decisive_test: Zero cost: required reaction time per Toffoli layer for tenfold is 0.39 ns (B8) and 0.051 ns (B4) at eps=0.001, k=3; compare with the photonic loss-free detection+feedforward floor stated in Litinski-Nickerson (reaction assumed ~1 us). If floor > required, the route cannot close and stays conditional.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Close as non-closing now (no GHz logical-layer substitution); defer the full resource-generator/delay model until HW-ACT.
notes: Its value is one sentence in the frontier paper: optical clock != dependency latency.

title: Millions of logical qubits in the emitted oracle are not an information lower bound
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x on the single-lane inequality (packing is depth-neutral, recomputation only adds depth); its only time effect is more E20 parallel lanes under a fixed physical budget (up to L, owned by E20), and the supply bound is lane-invariant
cheapest_decisive_test: None needed for the negative result (width never shortens the critical path). If activated: packing-only replay of the B4 source with the accepted compact SSA allocator, reporting peak width with zero added depth, before any checkpoint policy.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Single owner A06; defer the capped-schedule rebuild until HW-ACT or until E20 lane count is the binding lever. Reject any width gain without a clean replay (existing rule).
notes: Near-duplicate of A06: H15's next action is literally A06's integration. Priority 1 in the roadmap is not justified by its inequality effect; it matters only for physical feasibility after the time gap closes.

title: Classical parallelism is inexpensive in this benchmark but not literally free
optimistic_max_factor: <1.1x on rows that already use measured 16-worker wall time (C2/C09: T_C=22.5 s B8, 2.69 s B4 at eps=0.001, workers=16); a single-worker convention is bounded by T_1 <= 16*T_16, i.e. <=16x quantum-favourable, which this item would only shrink by measuring the real speedup
real_dependencies: Stage C item C6 (GPU arm, g in {1,10,100})
cheapest_decisive_test: Zero cost: re-score the decision point with T_C*16 as the quantum-favourable single-worker bound. Verdict unchanged: B8 miss 1,018x -> 64x at T-depth (16x with the H03 4x credit; 8x if the A16 uncompute credit is also granted), B4 7,807x -> 488x (122x / 61x). Measuring the 1-16 worker grid is needed only for G4 of an advantage claim.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Defer the scaling grid; run it only if a candidate's miss falls within 16x, or batch it into the next idle-machine Stage C timing session (C5/C7 timing) so it costs no extra scheduling. GPU arm stays 'unavailable' rather than triggering a download.
notes: Note for the negative frontier: when every quantum-favourable choice is stacked (k=3, 100 ns, 8x reaction credit, single-worker classical), B8 eps=0.001 is only ~8x short of tenfold (~1.25x onefold speedup). The robust margin therefore comes from the actual estimator constant (k_total ~853, longest-shot k ~57 for the audited $0.01 15-shot schedule), not from hardware or parallel accounting.

title: T depth alone does not determine runtime
optimistic_max_factor: n/a (certification): the logical ledger is reconciled (43 fixtures; N_T 5.12e14 B4 / 4.20e15 B8; tenfold supply thresholds 1.9e15-7.6e16 T/s); adding physical reaction/supply/routing terms can only add quantum time

A cell failing both at the floors is closed for all hardware routes. The G5 physical schedule (XL) is advantage-only.
kill_or_defer_criterion: Freeze physical-architecture attachment (the <=3 architectures) until HW-ACT: best credible D_reaction * k_eff / T_C within 10x of the 100 ns tenfold budget, i.e. D_reaction <= 10*D_max = 6,520 layers (B8x52) / 712 (B4x12) at eps=0.001, k=3; today 165,926-663,704 (B8) and 138,944-555,774 (B4). Never compute an 'achievable runtime' before G3 delivers a final estimator schedule.
notes: Owner of the family-wide HW-ACT trigger. Label max(reaction, supply, routing) as a necessary lower bound only.
